svg.title: Janeway Hero Board — editable SVG
svg.desc: 4500 × 2700 px board. Tuvok board geometry reused for vector panel shapes and placement. Janeway hero-board artwork is the background; individual ability art, panel titles, rules, and linked icons are editable or replaceable SVG elements.
